project.name: ST Improvisation to Score
project.primary_goal: Recover the final S13.2 merge gate by fixing the GGUF tuning-metadata verifier environment without weakening model provenance, learned-evidence authority boundaries, or existing runtime conformance.

required_method.rule: Fresh-read the current PR head before edits. Do not guess. Root cause first, one hypothesis at a time, smallest safe fix, then verify every required gate on the same final HEAD.

current_state.note: Documentation commits may move HEAD. Treat the branch/PR as source of truth and fresh-read at start.

verified_real_provider_evidence.interpretation: Engineering/runtime evidence only. Do not claim musical-quality improvement from these numbers.

current_blocker.failing_step: Verify TabCNN tuning metadata from GGUF

root_cause_evidence.confirmed_fact: The pinned CrispStrobe/ggml tree does not contain a gguf-py directory, so the workflow points PYTHONPATH at a nonexistent package path.

immutable_architecture_constraints: Basic Pitch remains the score-generation note/onset source.
TabCNN may not delete Basic Pitch notes, create/remove score voices, force final fingering, override teacher corrections, or block MusicXML.
Missing/mismatched model, unavailable executable, malformed provider output, timeout, or learned-provider failure remains non-blocking for score generation.
Do not commit model binaries or private user audio.
FretNet remains deferred until a separately verified checkpoint/provenance gate exists.
Do not weaken or skip exact model SHA-256 verification or runtime commit pinning.

execution_plan.action: Fresh-read PR #35, branch HEAD, workflow file, model manifest, S13.2 docs, and latest failing job logs.
execution_plan.acceptance: Observed failure still matches the recorded gguf import/path defect or the handoff is updated before any fix.

execution_plan.action: Reproduce the gguf import failure with a cheap preflight equivalent before the expensive real-guitar benchmark.
execution_plan.acceptance: Failure is deterministic and isolated from model inference.

execution_plan.action: Inspect the pinned CrispASR/ggml source tree and existing CrispASR patterns for making GGUFReader available. Compare working reference usage before selecting a fix.
execution_plan.acceptance: Chosen approach is tied to the pinned runtime and does not rely on an unpinned ambient package.

execution_plan.action: Write or extend a failing test/preflight that proves the metadata reader dependency/path is available and can read tabcnn.tuning from the exact verified GGUF.
execution_plan.acceptance: Test fails before implementation for the same root cause.

execution_plan.action: Implement the smallest deterministic fix. Prefer a pinned/reproducible dependency or a repository/runtime-native metadata reader path. Do not remove tuning verification.
execution_plan.acceptance: Cheap preflight passes and exact tuning is compared to config/models/tabcnn-f16.json.

execution_plan.action: Run the TabCNN Real Guitar Benchmark on the new HEAD and confirm READY + deterministic prediction digest.
execution_plan.acceptance: Benchmark succeeds and reports the pinned artifact hash, tuning, frame/prediction counts, and SHADOW_EVIDENCE_ONLY.

execution_plan.action: Run all six required gates on one exact final HEAD.
execution_plan.acceptance: CI, Score Editor Runtime, Guitar TAB Runtime, Real Audio E2E, TabCNN Artifact Provenance, and TabCNN Real Guitar Benchmark are all SUCCESS on that exact HEAD.

execution_plan.action: Fresh-read PR head after all workflows complete; verify no later commit invalidated the green runs.
execution_plan.acceptance: PR HEAD equals the SHA tested by all six gates.

execution_plan.action: Update docs/S13_2_TABCNN_REAL_PROVIDER.md and PR #35 body with final root cause, fix, exact successful workflow IDs, final HEAD, and benchmark evidence.
execution_plan.acceptance: No stale successful-run or blocker statements remain.

execution_plan.action: Merge PR #35 only if every acceptance condition is satisfied.
execution_plan.acceptance: Merge uses expected_head_sha protection and new main SHA is reported.

do_not_do: Do not silence or delete the GGUF tuning metadata check just to make CI green.
Do not replace exact SHA/runtime pins with floating latest versions.
Do not promote TabCNN to canonical/source-truth authority.
Do not change Basic Pitch admission/reconstruction behavior as part of this blocker fix.
Do not bundle unrelated refactors, FretNet work, browser inference, or playable TAB decoding into this recovery.
Do not claim musical transcription quality improved unless a separate human-reviewed quality evaluation supports it.
Do not merge with one red, skipped, stale, or differently-headed required gate.

include: six workflow names + run IDs + conclusions
merge result and new main SHA if merged
required_final_report.verdict_format: Use explicit ✅/❌ and distinguish runtime success from musical-quality evidence.
